context_requirements: Expression of the drug's annotated targets (CA2, HTR3A, KCNQ1) is not sufficient for a transcriptional response in these lines.
A functional distal nephron transport program, absent in these cell lines, would be required for the canonical thiazide mechanism.
No known transcriptional effector pathway is engaged by thiazides at 10 micromolar in standard cancer cell lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls.
Enrichment of ion transport, cell-volume, or calcium-signaling gene sets after treatment.
